name: Haus Scherl
beschreibung: Haus Scherl is located in a quiet yet central location in St. Anton am Arlberg, close to the pedestrian zone and the valley station of the Galzigbahn. The holiday apartments offer a fully equipped kitchen, a separate bedroom, and free Wi-Fi. There is no on-site culinary offering at the accommodation; however, the numerous restaurants and bars in the village are easily reachable on foot. In the surrounding area, the entire ski and hiking area of the Arlberg as well as an outdoor swimming pool are directly available. The atmosphere of the house is quiet and well-kept, with a traditional Tiroler ambience. A paid parking space complements the accommodation's offering.
